data.body: **[P2] Stop allocating live spans after final cleanup.** Removing `resetInvocationState()` leaves `tracingEnabled` true after this method resolves, and neither start hook checks a finalization flag. A losing `parallel` branch can resume when another plugin's awaited `onOperationStart` resolves after `minSuccessful` let the handler finish, creating an attempt span after this sweep. Core then leaves the branch's checkpoint unresolved because its ancestor finished, so neither an attempt-end hook nor further invocation cleanup closes that span. This regresses the previous disabled-after-end behavior and can leak active spans in a reused execution environment. Add a finalized gate for operation/attempt starts in both OTel views, preserve late external-completion draining separately, and test a delayed start hook released after `onInvocationEnd` resolves.
